title: "I had cancelled this"
story: ShopBot pays FreshMart INR 1,250 for Asha's weekly groceries. Afterwards Asha cancels ShopBot's permission, then tells her bank the payment came after she had cancelled. The Guard checks the timestamps: the permission was active when the Decision was made, so the evidence is strong.

steps.instruction: Order this week's groceries: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.
steps.item: Weekly groceries: milk, eggs, bread, fruit

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order this week's groceries, please: milk, eggs, bread and fruit, around 1,250 rupees.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart is INR 1,250. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: This week's basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: I don't want ShopBot paying for things any more. Cancelling its permission.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: I had cancelled ShopBot, and FreshMart still charged me. I've disputed it.

what_to_notice: The Revocation is in the records with its time, and so is the Decision. The Mandate was active when the Decision was made and was cancelled only afterwards, so "I had cancelled" doesn't hold. Revoking stops new payments; it doesn't undo one already made.
